title: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions… (CVE-2026-93680)
description: IBM Langflow OSS versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper authentication. This flaw could lead to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The vulnerability is rated critical with a CVSS score of 9.8.
